agencyOff: Agency mode is off on this instance. An instance admin turns it on in Instance admin › Instance & updates.

notStaff.message: The Agency area is for {agency}'s staff.

denied.note: what: a sentence subject such as 'Seeing usage and rates'; permission: agency:usage

deniedAsk.note: helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

what.library: Changing the library and workspace templates
notYoursOwner: Not yours to give: only a transfer of ownership makes someone the Owner
levelPick: Pick Agency manager or Account manager.
pickAccount: Pick an active account of this instance.

clientPerson.message: {name} is one of a client's own people. Client people never become agency staff.

alreadyAdmin: {name} is an instance admin, and instance admins are agency managers already.
assignmentInvalid: Pick a client and one of its roles.
staffClientRole: Client approver and Client viewer are for the client's own people. Give staff a role such as Admin or Editor.
adminLevel: Instance admins are agency managers. Remove the instance admin role first.
adminRemove: Instance admins are agency managers and can't be taken off the staff here. Remove the instance admin role in Instance admin › Users first.
removeSelf: You can't take yourself off the staff. Ask another agency manager.

escalation.message: You can assign only roles whose permissions you hold in that workspace. You're {role} in {workspace}, so {wanted} isn't available.
escalation.note: role: your role there; wanted: the role you tried to give

escalationNoRole: You can assign only roles whose permissions you hold in that workspace, and you have no role in {workspace}.

ask.note: helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

noAccountYet: {email} hasn't joined yet. Their invitations are pending; assign them once they have an account.
lastOwner: {name} is the last Owner of {workspace}. Transfer ownership to someone else first.
outranks: {name} holds more in {workspace} than you do, so you can't change their access there.
unassignSelf: You can't remove your own assignment. Ask an agency manager.
pickWorkspace: Pick one of this instance's workspaces.
pickTemplate: Pick one of the agency's workspace templates.
agencyNotClient: The agency's own workspace can't be one of its clients too.
pickStaff: Pick someone on the agency's staff.
notAgencyWorkspace: {workspace} isn't one of the agency's workspaces. An instance admin adds it in Instance admin › Instance & updates › Agency.
templateName: Name the template, like Retail starter.
templateNameTaken: A workspace template named “{name}” already exists. Choose another name.
smsFromComposer: SMS texts are used from the SMS composer's “Insert from library”.
flowNotInPlace: A flow can't be replaced in place. Use the library item again for a fresh draft.
kindMismatch: That item is a different kind of content.
libraryNameTaken: The library has an item named “{name}” already. Choose another name, or save it as a new version of that item.
emptyItem: This library item has nothing to copy.
copyGone: The copy in {workspace} was deleted. Copy the item again instead.
clientName: Name the client, like Wide World Importers.
slugInvalid: Use 2 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
slugTaken: The address {slug} is taken. Choose another.
timezone: Use a time zone like America/Chicago.
ownerManager: Pick an agency manager as the Owner.
firstPersonRole: The client's first person is a Client approver or a Client viewer.
agencyWorkspaceDelete: The agency's own workspace isn't a client. Delete it from Instance admin › Workspaces.
